gates.name: W108.5 The publish step is unreachable from a validation run
gates.command: node scripts/verify-release.mjs mode --event workflow_dispatch --ref refs/heads/main --input-tag v0.11.0
gates.detail: mode=validate. The workflow's publish step is gated on steps.mode.outputs.mode == 'publish', and the guard returns publish only when the event is a push and the ref starts with refs/tags/v — an input cannot produce it. Two release-workflow defects were fixed in the same change: npm publish now publishes the inspected archive by path after re-verifying its digest, instead of packing a second uninspected time; and the availability check no longer reads the ambient registry. No tag was pushed and no publish job ran.

conclusion.statement: This records release preparation and a full fresh verification pass. It does not authorize publication. Two of the six blockers are environmental and close on the pull request's own CI; two are decisions for the user; one is a companion-side fix outside W108; one is an unavailable database profile.

postCandidateCommits: Commits after 2b525d3 on this branch touch the verification path only (the release workflow, this record, RELEASE.md). The archive contains dist/, package.json and README.md, so none of them can change its bytes; the digest above is the check on that. The first of them fixes a defect the new validation path found in itself: the summary step ran `printf '- Registry availability guard...'`, whose format string starts with a dash, so bash read it as an option and the job exited 2. The guards themselves all passed in that run — the registry guard reported success in validate mode. That is the validation path doing its job on its first real execution, and it is the reason W108.5 asked for one.
